name: linear-tickets
description: Your Linear tickets in a side pane, with their status and a chart of how you are progressing: tickets grouped by state (in progress, todo, backlog, done), a stacked status bar, a bar chart of tickets closed per day over the last two weeks and, when your tickets sit in a cycle, that cycle's scope and completed burn-up. Read-only; it polls Linear's GraphQL API. /linear opens it. Needs a Linear API key.

linearApiKey.title: Linear API key
linearApiKey.description: A Linear personal API key (Linear, Settings, Security & access); with none set the mod does nothing. It only reads issues and cycles

assignee.title: Whose tickets
assignee.description: me lists tickets assigned to you; anyone lists everyone's (narrow it with teamKey or project)

teamKey.title: Team key
teamKey.description: Only this team's tickets, by its key (the CLA of CLA-143); empty for every team

project.title: Project name contains
project.description: Only tickets of Linear projects whose name contains this text (case-insensitive); empty for all

days.title: Days of history
days.description: How far back the done list and the closed-per-day chart reach (7-60)

pollSeconds.title: Refresh interval (s)
pollSeconds.description: Seconds between refreshes while the pane or the status line is on (30-3600)

status.title: Status line entry
status.description: Keep a summary (in progress, todo, done) under the prompt and keep polling while the pane is closed

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when the session starts; the engine keeps an unasked pane hidden below 144 columns
